name: ColorPicker
description: Full colour picker: HSV/HSL pad, hue/alpha bars, RGB/HSL/HSV/HEX fields, optional alpha, colour history and screen sampling.

fields.spacing: double? - gap between major sections, 12 by default
fields.controlSpacing: double? - gap between sliders/fields/buttons, 8 by default
fields.orientation: Axis? - vertical (pad above fields) by default
fields.enableEyeDropper: bool? - show the eye-dropper button, true by default
fields.sliderSize: double? - hue/alpha bar thickness, 24 by default
